title: The Seal Ring
lead: A seal ring (Hebrew chotam) carried its owner's mark and authority. In the Bible it stands for what a person holds close and for delegated power, and Jeremiah and Haggai use it of the Davidic line.

sections.b: Judah left his seal and cord with Tamar (Genesis 38:18); Pharaoh gave Joseph his ring (Genesis 41:42); the king's ring sealed Haman's decree and Mordecai's (Esther 3:10; 8:2); the lover asks to be set "as a seal" on the heart (Song of Songs 8:6). Jeremiah 22:24-25 says the LORD would pull Coniah off his hand like a seal ring, and Haggai 2:23 says the LORD will make Zerubbabel his seal ring. Sirach 49:11-12 uses the image of Zerubbabel again.
